caption: The drawing depicts a square piece of fabric featuring a grid pattern filled with various embroidered motifs in multiple colors, primarily reds, greens, yellows, blues, browns, and blacks. The outer edge is bordered with a repeating pattern of small red diamonds, with a second inner border of diagonal lines and leaf motifs. Within the central area, there are several stylized flowers in vases, loose flowers, birds, geometric shapes, two large star-like forms, and small fruit or berry shapes scattered throughout. A black animal figure, possibly a cat or dog, appears near the bottom left corner, and several birds or similar small creatures are present in various locations around the piece. The arrangement is symmetrical along the vertical axis, with many mirrored elements on either side of the center. At the bottom right of the image, there is a narrow cartouche with text, which is rendered in a red, cursive script. The background color of the fabric is a light neutral tone. The piece is mounted on a similarly light, plain background.
title: Sampler
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
